description: Daily vessel transits through the Panama Canal chokepoint, counted by ship type (container, dry bulk, general cargo, Ro-Ro, tanker) with capacity, from IMF PortWatch (ArcGIS, AIS-derived). Covers transit counts only, not booking slots or draft restrictions; the latest date lags real time by several days. Related tools on this server, for a different need: logistics_suez_canal_telemetry when you need daily vessel transits through the Suez Canal, counted; logistics_strait_malacca_transits when you need daily vessel transits through the Malacca Strait. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

days.description: How many most recent days, 1 to 30 (default 7)

name: logistics_panama_canal_transits
